summary.en: A wall of page cards tilted back in depth: three columns scroll at different speeds, the middle one reversed, while the camera creeps in; then they brake.
summary.zh: 后仰在纵深里的一面页面卡墙：三列差速滚动、中列反向，镜头缓推；结尾各列刹停。

fits: The breadth of a product (many pages, features or templates) in a few seconds, read as volume: a montage middle or the beat after an intro.
notFor: Reading any one page (hand over to a single-card scene); fewer than nine distinct cards; a second time in the same film.

overlaps.note: stream mode: cards arrive one by one on a pile; scroll-wall is a standing wall that flows
a wall switching on in place; scroll-wall is a wall in continuous flow

intent.en: Say 'there is far more than we can show you' in a few seconds: a standing wall of pages keeps flowing past, read as volume, never as detail.
intent.zh: 几秒钟里说清“多到给你看不完”：一面页面墙持续流过，读到的是体量，不是细节。

content.en: 9–15 distinct card-level crops of the film's pages (not whole pages), none repeated across columns; no text slots, the crops only need to look like real pages.
content.zh: 9–15 张互不重复的页面切图（卡片级，不是整页），各列之间不复用同一张；没有文字槽，切图只需看得出是真页面。

fits.zh: 几秒内交代产品的广度（很多页面、功能或模板），读作体量：蒙太奇中段，或片头之后那一拍。

notFor.zh: 要读某一页（交给单卡场景）；少于九张不同的卡；同一支片第二次出现。

pairs.note: deal the wall in first, then hand over to the flow
hand over when one page must be read

en: Each column's crops must be taller than the visible wall, or the same crop shows twice on screen.
Do not reuse a crop across columns; the same image in two columns reads as thin material.
It is an atmosphere shot: text on the crops only needs to look real; to have one page read, hand over to a single-card scene.
Once per film; a second waterfall reads as padding.
zh: 每列切图总高要超过可见墙高，否则同屏看到同一张两次。
列与列之间不复用同一张图；同图出现在两列读作素材穷。
这是氛围铺陈镜头：切图上的字只求看得出是真页面；要观众读某一页，交给单卡场景。
一支片只用一次；第二次读作凑时长。

upstream.name: 页面瀑布墙
upstream.summary: 页面瀑布墙——真实页面截图切成 3–4 列在 3D 后仰墙面上差速反向无限滚动，视差 + 镜头缓推做"内容多到流不完"的一览
upstream.use: "多页面/多功能/多模板"体量感段落；montage 中段铺陈或 intro 后的产品广度镜头
